plain: Training a model on pairs of answers, one better and one worse, so it learns to prefer the better kind without a separate reward model.
eli5: Showing the robot a good answer and a bad answer side by side, again and again, until it picks the good kind by itself.
technical: A fine-tuning objective (Rafailov et al., 2023) that raises the policy's log-probability ratio, relative to a frozen reference model, for preferred over dispreferred responses, replacing RLHF's reward model and RL step with a single classification-style loss.
